title: Local review requests recode before PR continuation
description: Simulates a fully local review cycle where the critic finds blocking issues and requires recode before the flow can continue. No GitHub, Linear, LiteLLM or production services are used.

candidate.prompt: Run a deterministic local critic loop. The first review round must require recode because of a blocking issue. The second round must resolve the blocking issue, downgrade the remaining note to an operational caveat and allow the flow to continue to PR.
candidate.commitMessage:
test(eval): recode after blocking review

Ref: MAC-86
Co-authored-by: Codex <noreply@openai.com>

rounds.summary: Blocking issue found; implementation must be revised before PR progression.

criticFeedback.message: Behavior diverges from the expected contract and requires code changes.

rounds.summary: Recode addressed the issue; remaining note is operational only.

criticFeedback.message: Monitor the rollout, but no product-level blocker remains.

report.blockReason: recode-required on round 1, resolved on round 2
